# spaceman session

Your sign-in sessions: list and revoke.

Aliases: `sessions`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman session list`](#spaceman-session-list) | Your active sessions |
| [`spaceman session revoke`](#spaceman-session-revoke) | Revoke one of your sessions |

## spaceman session list

Your active sessions.

```sh
spaceman session list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-sessions` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman session revoke

Revoke one of your sessions.

```sh
spaceman session revoke <session> [flags]
```

API: `revoke-session` ([HTTP API](../api)).
